# Stop-ZbxActiveAgent

## SYNOPSIS

Stops an active agent session.

## SYNTAX

```
Stop-ZbxActiveAgent [-Name] <string> [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

The Stop-ZbxActiveAgent cmdlet stops the active agent session named in -Name, or each session piped from Get-ZbxActiveAgentStatus: the agent stops asking the server for its items and pushing values, and is removed from the runspace. A session also stops when the runspace closes. -WhatIf shows which session it would stop, and it writes nothing.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Stop an active agent by name

```powershell
Start-ZbxActiveAgent -Name 'web-agent' -Hostname 'web-01' -Server 'zabbix.example:10051'
Stop-ZbxActiveAgent -Name 'web-agent'
@(Get-ZbxActiveAgentStatus).Count
```

Stops the session's send loop and disposes it; values it had not delivered yet are dropped with it.

### Example 2: Stop every active agent of this runspace

```powershell
Start-ZbxActiveAgent -Name 'web-agent' -Hostname 'web-01' -Server 'zabbix.example:10051'
Start-ZbxActiveAgent -Name 'db-agent' -Hostname 'db-01' -Server 'zabbix.example:10051'
Get-ZbxActiveAgentStatus | Stop-ZbxActiveAgent
@(Get-ZbxActiveAgentStatus).Count
```

Get-ZbxActiveAgentStatus writes each running session; Stop-ZbxActiveAgent binds its Name from the pipeline.

### Example 3: Preview a stop with -WhatIf

```powershell
Start-ZbxActiveAgent -Name 'web-agent' -Hostname 'web-01' -Server 'zabbix.example:10051'
Stop-ZbxActiveAgent -Name 'web-agent' -WhatIf
Stop-ZbxActiveAgent -Name 'web-agent'
```

-WhatIf names the session it would stop and leaves it running. ConfirmImpact is Medium: -Confirm asks first.

## PARAMETERS

The session's name (the -Name it was started with).
